mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.username, u.building, u.room_no, r.type, r.description, r.urgency, r.images, r.status, r.result, r.accept_time, r.finish_time, r.cancel_time, r.create_time, rc.star AS star, rc.content AS comment_content FROM repair_order r JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN repair_comment rc ON rc.order_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
